A kafeneio on Zik Zak

Xouzouri is a small kafeneio and bar in Zik Zak, one of the quiet alleys of Limassol’s old town. Tables stand in the lane under a tree, inside the walls are full of pictures. Guests come for coffee in the day and a cold beer and live music at night. One review praises the owner for keeping the standard since the opening, for many years.
